To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The management of mobile agent systems is a complex task that requires a lot of human intervention and is not well supported by current systems.
mobile agent platforms are difficult to manage because: 1. they are distributed, 2. they are autonomous, 3. they are dynamic, 4. they are heterogeneous, and 5. they are not transparent.
Mobile agent platforms must be designed from the ground up to be manageable, or they will be unmanageable".
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (i) how to manage a mobile agent infrastructure, (ii) how to reduce the management overhead, and (iii) how to design a mobile agent platform that does not require any management.
the development of a generic mobile agent infrastructure, with a strong emphasis on manageability, that is suitable for a wide range of mobile agent applications.
the following question: how can the manageability requirements of mobile agent infrastructures be alleviated?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
manageability of mobile agent infrastructures remains an open problem, but that the problem is not hopeless.
manageability is an issue that must be addressed at the early stages of the development of any new agent platform.

the management requirements of mobile agents are not as severe as they are usually thought, and that the management requirements are mainly due to the current implementations of the mobile agent concept, and not to the mobile agents themselves.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mobile agent systems are not as bad as some people say, but they are not as good either.

we are trying to provide the means for managing mobile agent infrastructures in a similar way as we are used to manage other distributed applications, such as web servers, databases or e-commerce systems.
the manageability of a mobile agent system should not be an afterthought but should be taken into consideration from the start of the design of the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mobile agent infrastructures should be managed by a centralized management system, which is able to monitor and control the whole distributed system.
mobile agents should be designed with manageability in mind from the beginning.
mobile agents are a very promising technology, but that they need to be used in a different way than the one currently adopted in the vast majority of the existing mobile agent platforms.
